name: pdf-card-mcp
description: Local-first MCP server and CLI for turning PDFs into source-linked HTML readers, then validating or publishing notes/highlights as static annotated bundles.
long_description: PDF Card Reader lets an MCP host or terminal command turn a local PDF path into a portable HTML reader. Conversion runs locally by default, preserves source text, includes source-page previews for verification, embeds detected table, figure, and formula crops, derives safe styling from the PDF palette, and writes a standalone reader that can move across devices without a hosted service. The MCP server can also validate annotation sidecars and publish selected public notes/highlights as static annotated bundles. Optional sampling is deliberately bounded: the host model may choose validated style tokens or suggest card-boundary polish, but raw CSS and source-text rewrites are rejected.
